name: logseq-block-ids
description: Work safely with Logseq block IDs (`id::` properties) and `((uuid))` block references when moving, copying, or removing blocks across graph pages. Use when relocating a block that has an id::, creating a new ((ref)) to a block, deciding whether an id:: can be removed, or diagnosing refs that won't render. Baseline safety (never backtick a live ref/link; keep id:: with its block) is in logseq-core; this skill has the full move/copy/reindex procedures.
